title: Moving to COD warns about limits and asks first, Cancel keeps choices
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure Net 30 is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Create a new term of the shop's own for this test, term A, due 15 days after the invoice date.
  • Create three customers for this test on term A, with credit limits of $500.00, $0.00 and $1,000.00.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the term A row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Choose "COD" in "Move To".
  4. Click "Move 3 Customers".
  5. Click "Cancel".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • A window titled "Move Customers from term A" opens.

Step 3:

  • The line "Their credit limit will be set to $0." shows below "Move To".

Step 4:

  • A confirmation opens titled "Set 3 customers' credit limit to $0?" with the message "This can't be undone. Their current limits are kept in each customer's note, and the Credit Terms Log records the move." and the buttons "Cancel" and a red "Set Limits To $0 And Move".

Step 5:

  • The confirmation closes and the Move Customers window is back with all three ticked and "Move To" still COD.
  • Nobody was moved.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
